definition: The history of natural language processing describes the advances of natural language processing.
details: There is some overlap with the history of machine translation, the history of speech recognition, and the history of artificial intelligence.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. That pattern-earned fluency is History of natural language processing.
